title: Secdepth advisory matches
description: Written by match.py. Lists only the fields other tools may rely on; producers may add optional fields in any 1.x version.

id.description: CVE ID when one exists, otherwise GHSA or OSV ID.

details.description: Advisory text; secpeel evidence looks for class and function names in it.

symbols.description: Added in 1.1. Vulnerable symbols from OSV: Go package path plus symbol (golang.org/x/crypto/ssh.NewServerConn) or Rust function path (regex::Regex::new).
